questions.question: Which of the following is considered a strong password?
questions.hint: A strong password usually mixes uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
options: To provide an extra layer of security beyond just a password
questions.hint: Think of it as having two different locks on a single door.

questions.question: You receive an urgent email from your bank asking you to click a link and 'verify' your account details. What is this common attack called?
questions.hint: This attack 'fishes' for your private information using a deceptive lure.

questions.question: When using public Wi-Fi at a cafe, why is it recommended to use a VPN (Virtual Private Network)?
options: To increase the internet connection speed
To prevent your device from overheating
To encrypt your data and protect it from eavesdroppers
questions.hint: A VPN creates a secure 'tunnel' for your data to travel through.

questions.question: Under the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), which right allows a user to request that a company permanently delete all their personal data?
options: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
questions.hint: This right focuses on the complete removal of data from a company's systems.
